result.brief: 提出 LMMR：将文本隐状态与视觉 patch 特征映射到共享稀疏自编码器概念空间，构建多模态记忆图并以连续残差注入生成主干，实现长时多模态记忆推理。
result.reason: Maps visual patch and text hidden states into a shared sparse-autoencoder latent concept space with graph aggregation injected into a generation backbone—a multimodal latent representation contribution.
